mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, status, created_at, updated_at FROM notice WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, title, content, status, created_at, updated_at FROM notice ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, title, content, status, created_at, updated_at FROM notice WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, status) VALUES (#{request.title}, #{request.content}, COALESCE(#{request.status}, 1))
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{request.title}, content = #{request.content}, status = COALESCE(#{request.status}, 1) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notice SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
